project.name: NeuroSignal India — Dynamic AI Traffic Flow Optimizer & Emergency Grid

environment.llm_provider: Google Gemini via google-genai (use currently available stable model; default gemini-2.5-flash)

project.problem_statement: Create an intelligent traffic management system that uses real-time computer vision to dynamically adjust signal timings based on live traffic density. The system must also enable an AI-powered green corridor feature to prioritize and clear routes for emergency vehicles such as ambulances and fire services.
project.solution_summary: Software-only MVP with three layers: (1) MetaDrive IntersectionEnv provides a 2D top-down orthographic view at 748 FPS — this IS the virtual CCTV camera, no hardware needed. (2) YOLOv8n runs real-time CV on those frames, counting vehicles per N/S/E/W zone via supervision PolygonZone, applying IRC PCE weights to get India-standard traffic load scores per zone — directly satisfying the 'real-time computer vision' requirement. (3) Gemini 2.0 Flash receives PCE text state + top-down image in one multimodal call, reasons with an India-specific system prompt, returns a validated SignalDecision via instructor+Pydantic, applied to MetaDrive signals via engine.traffic_manager. On ambulance detection, Dijkstra on a real Delhi road graph (osmnx) computes optimal route, injected as LLM emergency context for green corridor reasoning. React dashboard streams everything live.

all_components.note: Complete record of every component mentioned across all architecture discussions. MVP=currently being built. Phase2=deferred. Reference=code studied not run. Optional=stretch goal.

MetaDrive_0_4_3.role: Simulation engine + top-down frame renderer + traffic signal state manager
MetaDrive_0_4_3.detail: IntersectionEnv provides 4-way intersection with built-in traffic lights. env.render(mode='topdown') returns 800x800 numpy RGB array every step — this IS the virtual CCTV. Signal control via env.engine.traffic_manager. 748 FPS confirmed headless. Installed and verified.
MetaDrive_0_4_3.signal_control_api: Verify at runtime: use BaseTrafficLight.set_green/set_red/set_yellow or traffic_manager helper if present

YOLOv8n.role: Real-time vehicle detection on MetaDrive top-down frames
YOLOv8n.detail: COCO classes used: motorcycle=3 (PCE 0.5), car=2 (PCE 1.0), bus=5 (PCE 2.5), truck=7 (PCE 2.5). Ambulance detected via red color heuristic (HSV mask) as fallback. Fine-tuned ambulance class is stretch goal T02.6. No homography needed — top-down is already orthographic.

supervision_PolygonZone.role: Divides 800x800 top-down frame into N/S/E/W quadrant zones for per-direction vehicle counting
supervision_PolygonZone.detail: 4 PolygonZone instances with pixel-coordinate polygons for each approach direction. zone.trigger(detections) assigns each YOLO detection to its zone. No lane detection needed — zones replace lane logic for India lane-less traffic.

PCE_Calculator.role: Converts raw YOLO vehicle class counts to India IRC-standard Passenger Car Equivalent weighted load
PCE_Calculator.detail: PCE weights: two_wheeler/motorcycle=0.5, auto_rickshaw=1.2, car=1.0, minibus=1.5, truck/bus=2.5. Output per zone: {total_pce, count, tw_ratio, breakdown}. tw_ratio used for two-wheeler bonus (+5s green if tw_ratio > 0.6). PCE values feed LLM prompt and green time formula.

Gemini_2_0_Flash.role: Core AI product — multimodal signal control agent with chain-of-thought reasoning
Gemini_2_0_Flash.detail: Receives structured PCE state text + top-down MetaDrive frame as image in one multimodal API call. Reasons using India system prompt encoding PCE formula, lane-less rules, starvation prevention, emergency protocol. Returns SignalDecision with full chain-of-thought reasoning text. Free tier sufficient for 10-second decision intervals.
Gemini_2_0_Flash.reference: KDD 2025 LLMLight approach — LLM-as-agent for TSC, gold medal Geneva Inventions

instructor_pydantic.role: Guarantees Gemini returns valid structured SignalDecision Pydantic model — no JSON parsing or error handling needed
instructor_pydantic.detail: instructor wraps the Gemini client. If LLM returns malformed output, instructor automatically retries with validation error in context. SignalDecision model enforces: phase in allowed values, duration_s in [15,60], reasoning min_length=20.

LLMTSCS_LLMLight.role: Academic reference implementation — LLM-as-agent for traffic signal control (KDD 2025, Geneva Gold Medal)
LLMTSCS_LLMLight.detail: usail-hkust/LLMTSCS. Study models/chatgpt.py for agent loop pattern and run_chatgpt.py for CityFlow integration. Our Gemini agent follows the same prompt-reason-apply pattern adapted for MetaDrive and India context.

MetaDrive_Signal_Controller.role: Applies LLM SignalDecision back to MetaDrive traffic lights — MVP equivalent of SUMO TraCI
MetaDrive_Signal_Controller.detail: Maps phase strings (north/south/east/west) to MetaDrive traffic light object IDs found via env.engine.traffic_manager.traffic_lights dict. Holds green for duration_s steps, applies 5-step yellow. This module is designed so it can be swapped for traci.trafficlight.setPhase() in Phase 2 with minimal code change.
MetaDrive_Signal_Controller.note: Production equivalent: SUMO traci.trafficlight.setPhase() — same concept, different API

Rule_Based_Controller.role: Dual purpose: (1) LLM fallback on Gemini timeout/error (2) Benchmark baseline controller for KPI comparison
Rule_Based_Controller.detail: Algorithm: pressure_score = PCE * log(1 + wait_s) per zone. Pick highest-score zone as phase. Duration = PCE formula. Skip empty zones. Sub-millisecond response. Logged with controller_type='rule_based' in SQLite for benchmark comparison.

Safety_Enforcer.role: Hard safety constraints applied to every LLM output before signal is applied — SLO enforcement layer
Safety_Enforcer.detail: Rules: clamp duration_s to [15,60], override if any zone wait_s > 90s (starvation), set duration_s >= 30 if emergency_detected, remove non-empty zones from skip_phases. Wraps every LLM AND rule-based decision.

osmnx.role: Downloads real Delhi road graph from OpenStreetMap for Dijkstra ambulance routing
osmnx.detail: Deferred in current sprint. Routing uses a locally generated weighted random graph for fast iteration and no network dependency. Delhi OSM graph remains an optional realism upgrade.

networkx_Dijkstra.role: Computes optimal ambulance route on Delhi road graph — injected as LLM emergency context
networkx_Dijkstra.detail: Current implementation computes shortest paths on a local weighted random graph for development. Swap input graph to Delhi OSM graph in realism phase.

FastAPI.role: REST API + ASGI server hosting Socket.IO for real-time dashboard communication
FastAPI.detail: Endpoints: POST /api/emergency, POST /api/control, GET /health, GET /api/kpi, GET /api/decisions. Background asyncio task runs simulation loop. CORS enabled for React dev server on port 5173.

python_socketio.role: WebSocket server — streams simulation state to React dashboard in real time
python_socketio.detail: Emits 5 event types: 'frame' (annotated JPEG base64, throttled 10/s), 'decision' (LLM SignalDecision + reasoning), 'kpi' (avg_wait comparison every 2s), 'zones' (N/S/E/W PCE values every frame), 'emergency' (corridor state + countdown).

SQLite_sqlite_utils.role: Persistent decision log for KPI computation and benchmark comparison
SQLite_sqlite_utils.detail: Table: decisions (step, junction_id, phase, duration_s, reasoning, emergency, pce_n/s/e/w, avg_wait_s, latency_ms, controller_type). controller_type = 'llm'|'rule_based'|'fixed_timer'. get_kpi_summary() aggregates per controller for benchmark report.

React_Vite_Recharts.role: Judge-facing dashboard — 4 panels: camera feed, LLM reasoning stream, KPI chart, PCE zone bars
React_Vite_Recharts.detail: Camera feed: base64 JPEG updating at 10fps with YOLO boxes and signal state badges. Reasoning feed: typewriter effect for CoT text, emergency cards highlighted red. KPI chart: two Recharts lines (LLM green vs fixed red) diverging over time. PCE zone bars: 4 directional cards with color-coded load bars.

pandas.role: KPI aggregation from SQLite — generates benchmark comparison CSV and chart data
pandas.detail: Reads decisions.db via SQLite. Aggregates avg_wait_s, ambulance_corridor_time, throughput per controller_type. Outputs benchmark/results.csv. Used by benchmark/run_all.py for comparison report.

SUMO_TraCI.role: Real-world traffic signal control API for connecting to city intersection hardware via RS485/UDP
SUMO_TraCI.detail: traci.trafficlight.setPhase() is the production equivalent of MetaDrive engine.traffic_manager used in MVP. When deploying to real intersections, the MetaDrive signal controller module (T03.7) is swapped for a SUMO TraCI equivalent with minimal code change. Also provides SUMO simulation for production-grade benchmarking.
SUMO_TraCI.why_deferred: Requires separate SUMO installation (sudo apt install sumo), Delhi .net.xml network generation via osmnx-to-SUMO converter (netconvert), and TrafficDojo sync bridge for dual-sim. Adds 2-3 days of setup with no competition demo benefit since MetaDrive already provides simulation and signal control.
SUMO_TraCI.install: sudo apt install sumo && pip install traci sumo-rl

TrafficDojo.role: Synchronisation bridge between SUMO (signal control) and MetaDrive (3D visuals) — only needed when both are running simultaneously
TrafficDojo.detail: TrafficDojo mirrors vehicle positions, speeds, and signal states between SUMO and MetaDrive at each timestep. Also provides RGB cameras at intersection pole height (10m) in MetaDrive for photorealistic CCTV simulation alongside SUMO signal control. Paper: 'TrafficDojo: A Simulation Framework for Safe Autonomous Driving Research' (2024). MVP avoids this by using MetaDrive-only — no sync needed.
TrafficDojo.why_deferred: Only necessary in Phase 2 when SUMO handles signal control and MetaDrive handles 3D visuals simultaneously. For MVP, MetaDrive handles both roles alone — no bridge required.

CoLLMLight.role: Cooperative multi-agent LLM coordination — each junction's agent communicates with adjacent agents for city-wide green wave optimisation
CoLLMLight.detail: usail-hkust/CoLLMLight (2025). Extends LLMLight with inter-agent communication via GPT-4o. Agents share downstream congestion data to pre-emptively adjust timing. Directly implements the multi-junction green wave coordination discussed in architecture. MVP uses single-junction reasoning — CoLLMLight is the natural upgrade path.
CoLLMLight.why_deferred: Multi-agent adds API cost (N calls per decision step), latency, and coordination logic. Single-junction MVP is sufficient for competition. CoLLMLight is the post-competition scaling path.

LightSim2.role: Ultra-fast headless traffic simulation for statistical benchmarking (20,000 steps/second)
LightSim2.detail: pip install lightsim2. 16 real-world city scenarios built-in. Gymnasium + PettingZoo API. 4x faster than SUMO for batch KPI runs. Use for running 30-seed statistical comparison if MetaDrive benchmark (T07) needs stronger statistical evidence. Not needed if MetaDrive single-seed benchmark is sufficient for competition.
LightSim2.status_note: Optional stretch — add to T07 if more rigorous statistics needed

wandb.role: Visual experiment tracking for KPI comparison across all 3 controllers — already in LLMTSCS requirements.txt
wandb.detail: Log avg_wait_s, latency_ms, emergency_count per controller per step to wandb dashboard. Generates publication-quality comparison charts automatically. Optional if SQLite + matplotlib (T07.3) is sufficient for competition pitch slide.
wandb.status_note: Optional — add if time permits in T07

Includes runtime-safe config-key gating across MetaDriveEnv and MultiAgentIntersectionEnv to avoid class-specific config KeyError failures. This task creates the virtual environment that serves as both simulation engine and virtual CCTV camera.

subtasks.title: Define Indian vehicle type distribution
subtasks.description: Create config/india_vehicles.py. BHARAT_VEHICLE_MIX spawn ratios: two_wheeler=0.55, auto_rickshaw=0.20, car=0.15, minibus=0.07, truck=0.03. PCE_WEIGHTS dict: TWO_WHEELER=0.5, AUTO=1.2, CAR=1.0, MINIBUS=1.5, TRUCK=2.5. Map to MetaDrive vehicle config overrides (length, width, max_speed per type). These PCE_WEIGHTS are imported by cv/pce_calculator.py and embedded in agent/prompts.py.

subtasks.title: Spawn ambulance as special vehicle
subtasks.description: Create envs/ambulance_spawner.py. Function spawn_ambulance(env, origin_direction: str) -> str (vehicle_id). Spawns vehicle with color=(255,0,0). Sets metadata type=ambulance on vehicle object. Returns vehicle_id for corridor tracking. Red color is detectable by cv/detector.py HSV heuristic (T02.3). Called by emergency/corridor.py when corridor activates.
subtasks.test: Red vehicle visible in top-down frame after spawn_ambulance(env, 'north') call

subtasks.title: Main simulation loop
subtasks.description: Create main.py. Loop: env.reset() then while not done: action=env.action_space.sample(), obs,r,done,info = env.step(action), frame = env.render(mode='topdown'). Every LLM_DECISION_INTERVAL steps: pass frame + vehicle state to CV pipeline and LLM agent. Include incident telemetry (crash_vehicle_events, out_of_road_events), manual_throttle_scale reporting, and lidar-aware adaptive throttle scaling in manual control mode. Thread-safe frame buffer (threading.Lock) so FastAPI broadcaster can read latest frame. Graceful KeyboardInterrupt with env.close().
subtasks.test: Simulation runs 1000 steps, prints step/FPS, no crash

subtasks.title: Regression guards for env mode and IDM wiring
subtasks.description: Add tests in tests/test_env_mode_guards.py covering: fail-fast when multi-agent backend is missing, and conservative IDM policy wiring in multi-agent mode (TIME_WANTED, DISTANCE_WANTED, lane-change toggle and deceleration policy controls).
subtasks.test: pytest tests/test_env_mode_guards.py validates mode guard + conservative IDM config propagation

subtasks.title: MetaDrive config-key compatibility guard
subtasks.description: Implemented _supports_config_key(...) in envs/intersection_env.py and gated class-specific IDM keys against target env default_config(). This prevents unsupported keys from being injected into MetaDriveEnv while preserving MultiAgentIntersectionEnv behavior.
subtasks.test: Backend startup no longer fails with KeyError on unsupported enable_idm_lane_change/disable_idm_deceleration keys

tasks.title: Computer vision pipeline (YOLOv8 + supervision + PCE)
tasks.description: Real-time CV pipeline on MetaDrive top-down frames. Directly satisfies problem statement 'real-time computer vision' requirement. YOLOv8n detects vehicles. supervision PolygonZone counts per N/S/E/W quadrant. PCE weights convert counts to India-standard traffic load. Ambulance detected by color heuristic. No homography needed — top-down is orthographic.

subtasks.title: Install and baseline-test YOLOv8 + supervision
subtasks.description: pip install ultralytics supervision opencv-python. Test: model = YOLO('yolov8n.pt'); results = model('data/test_frame.png'). Print detected classes and bounding boxes. Verify vehicles detected. COCO class mapping: motorcycle=3, car=2, bus=5, truck=7. Document which classes are reliably detected in MetaDrive top-down frames (top-down is unusual angle — verify detection quality).
subtasks.test: YOLO detects at least some vehicles in test_frame.png. Bounding boxes printed.

subtasks.title: Define N/S/E/W PolygonZones
subtasks.description: Create cv/zone_config.py. Open data/test_frame.png in image viewer and identify pixel boundaries of each approach arm. Define 4 polygon arrays: NORTH_ZONE (top strip — vehicles queuing to enter from north), SOUTH_ZONE (bottom), EAST_ZONE (right), WEST_ZONE (left). CENTER_ZONE excluded (intersection box). Create supervision.PolygonZone for each. Draw all zones on test_frame.png and save as data/zones_debug.png to verify placement.
subtasks.test: data/zones_debug.png shows 4 colored polygon overlays in correct quadrants

subtasks.title: Vehicle detection and zone assignment
subtasks.description: Create cv/detector.py. Function detect_zones(frame: np.ndarray) -> dict. Steps: (1) YOLO inference on frame. (2) Filter detections: keep classes [2,3,5,7]. (3) zone.trigger(detections) assigns each detection to a zone. (4) Ambulance heuristic: convert frame to HSV, check if any bounding box region has dominant red pixels (H<10 or H>170, S>100) — if yes set ambulance_detected=True, ambulance_direction=zone_name. Return: {north: sv.Detections, south: ..., east: ..., west: ..., ambulance_detected: bool, ambulance_direction: Optional[str]}.
subtasks.test: detect_zones(test_frame) returns dict with all 4 zones populated. No crash on empty frame.

subtasks.title: PCE calculation per zone
subtasks.description: Create cv/pce_calculator.py. Import PCE_WEIGHTS from config/india_vehicles.py. YOLO_CLASS_TO_PCE = {3: PCE_WEIGHTS.TWO_WHEELER, 2: PCE_WEIGHTS.CAR, 5: PCE_WEIGHTS.TRUCK, 7: PCE_WEIGHTS.TRUCK}. Function compute_pce(detections: sv.Detections) -> dict: iterate detection class_ids, sum PCE weights, compute tw_ratio = motorcycle_count / max(total,1). Function compute_all_zones(zone_dict) -> dict[str, ZoneState]: applies compute_pce per zone, adds wait_s (tracked externally).
subtasks.test: compute_pce with mock detections [car,car,motorcycle,motorcycle,motorcycle] returns total_pce=3.5, tw_ratio=0.6

subtasks.title: Frame annotation for dashboard
subtasks.description: Create cv/annotator.py. Function annotate_frame(frame, zone_results, decision) -> bytes. Draw: (1) Zone polygon outlines — north=blue, south=green, east=orange, west=purple. (2) YOLO bounding boxes with class name. (3) PCE value text in corner of each zone. (4) Signal state badge per approach (GREEN/RED/YELLOW). (5) Red flashing border + 'CORRIDOR ACTIVE' text when ambulance_detected. cv2.imencode('.jpg', annotated) to return JPEG bytes for Socket.IO broadcast.
subtasks.test: annotate_frame returns JPEG bytes. Save to PNG and verify all annotations visible.

subtasks.title: YOLOv8 ambulance fine-tuning (stretch goal)
subtasks.description: STRETCH GOAL - only if days 1-6 complete early. Capture 100+ MetaDrive frames with red ambulance spawned. Annotate ambulance bounding boxes on Roboflow (free tier). Export YOLOv8 format. Fine-tune: yolo train model=yolov8n.pt data=ambulance.yaml epochs=30 imgsz=800. Save to models/ambulance_yolov8n.pt if training data and time are available. Current repo path still uses the red color-heuristic fallback in cv/detector.py, which is the active demo-ready behavior because the fine-tuned artifact is not present.
subtasks.test: If the fine-tuned model exists, it detects ambulance at >0.7 confidence; otherwise the red color heuristic fallback in cv/detector.py remains reliable for demo frames.

tasks.title: LLM agent — signal control core
tasks.description: Core AI product. Study LLMTSCS/run_chatgpt.py as reference. Build Gemini multimodal agent: PCE text state + top-down image → SignalDecision via instructor. India system prompt encodes all traffic rules. Safety enforcer clamps every output. Signal controller applies decisions to MetaDrive. Rule-based controller provides fallback and benchmark baseline.
tasks.reference_study: Before writing code: clone https://github.com/usail-hkust/LLMTSCS, read models/chatgpt.py (agent loop) and run_chatgpt.py (env integration). Adapt the pattern for Gemini + MetaDrive.

subtasks.title: Pydantic data models
subtasks.description: Create agent/models.py. SignalDecision(BaseModel): phase: Literal['north','south','east','west','north_south','east_west'], duration_s: int = Field(ge=15, le=60), skip_phases: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list), emergency_detected: bool = False, emergency_direction: Optional[str] = None, reasoning: str = Field(min_length=20). ZoneState(BaseModel): pce: float, count: int, tw_ratio: float, wait_s: int, ambulance_detected: bool. IntersectionState(BaseModel): junction_id: str, step: int, zones: dict[str, ZoneState], emergency_active: bool = False, emergency_route: Optional[list[str]] = None.
subtasks.test: SignalDecision(phase='north', duration_s=42, reasoning='test reason for long enough') validates. SignalDecision(duration_s=5) raises ValidationError.

subtasks.title: India system prompt
subtasks.description: Create agent/prompts.py. INDIA_SYSTEM_PROMPT must include ALL of: (1) Role definition: Delhi intersection signal controller. (2) PCE weights table (bike=0.5, AUTO=1.2, car=1.0, truck=2.5). (3) Green time formula: green_s = clamp(15 + 1.5 * zone_PCE, 15, 60). (4) Two-wheeler bonus: +5s if tw_ratio > 0.6. (5) Starvation rule: never allow any approach wait > 90s. (6) Skip rule: skip phases where PCE = 0 (no vehicles). (7) Yellow note: always 5s — not in your decision. (8) Emergency protocol: ambulance = green for 30s min, all others red, explain corridor. (9) Lane-less context: India traffic fills gaps, no lane discipline, PCE more reliable than count. (10) Output format: JSON only matching provided schema, no markdown. Also add EMERGENCY_CONTEXT_TEMPLATE string for T04.5.
subtasks.test: Manually verify all 10 rules present in prompt string

subtasks.title: State-to-prompt converter
subtasks.description:
Create agent/state_builder.py. Function build_state_prompt(state: IntersectionState) -> str. Format: 'Junction {id} | Step {n}
Approach states:
  NORTH: {count} vehicles, PCE={pce:.1f}, wait={wait_s}s, bikes={tw_pct}%, recommended_green={rec}s{flags}
  SOUTH: ...
  EAST: ...
  WEST: ...
'. flags = ' [STARVATION WARNING: {wait_s}s]' if wait_s > 90, ' [AMBULANCE DETECTED]' if ambulance_detected, ' [SKIP — EMPTY]' if count == 0. If state.emergency_active: append EMERGENCY_CONTEXT_TEMPLATE formatted with route.
subtasks.test: build_state_prompt(mock_state) returns multi-line string with all 4 zones and correct flags

subtasks.title: Gemini multimodal agent call
subtasks.description: Create agent/llm_agent.py. Load GEMINI_API_KEY from .env. Setup: client = instructor.from_provider("google/gemini-2.5-flash"). Function decide_signal(state: IntersectionState, frame: np.ndarray) -> SignalDecision: (1) cv2.imencode('.jpg', frame) → base64 data URL. (2) Build messages with image_url + text from build_state_prompt(state). (3) Use client.create(response_model=SignalDecision, messages=messages) for structured output validation via Instructor/Pydantic. (4) On exception: fallback to rule_based_decision(state). Record latency_ms and controller_type.
subtasks.test: decide_signal(mock_state, test_frame) returns valid SignalDecision with reasoning in <5s

subtasks.title: Safety enforcer
subtasks.description: Create agent/safety.py. Function enforce_safety(decision: SignalDecision, state: IntersectionState) -> SignalDecision. Apply rules in order: (1) duration_s = clamp(decision.duration_s, 15, 60). (2) Check all zones: if any zone wait_s > 90 and zone direction not in skip_phases and not currently being served: override phase to that zone, log WARNING 'Starvation override'. (3) If emergency_detected and duration_s < 30: set duration_s = 30. (4) Remove from skip_phases any zone with count > 0. Log all overrides. Return modified decision. Every LLM and rule-based decision passes through this.
subtasks.test: enforce_safety(SignalDecision(duration_s=5,...)) returns decision with duration_s=15

subtasks.title: Rule-based fallback and baseline controller
subtasks.description: Create agent/rule_based.py. Function rule_based_decision(state: IntersectionState) -> SignalDecision. Algorithm: (1) For each zone: pressure_score = pce * math.log1p(wait_s) if count > 0 else 0. (2) best_zone = argmax(pressure_score). (3) duration_s = clamp(15 + 1.5 * best_pce + (5 if tw_ratio > 0.6 else 0), 15, 60). (4) skip_phases = [d for d,z in zones.items() if z.count == 0]. (5) reasoning = f'Rule-based: {phase} pressure_score={score:.2f}, PCE={pce:.1f}, wait={wait_s}s'. Also check emergency_active — if True, delegate to corridor logic. Sub-millisecond response required.
subtasks.test: rule_based_decision(mock_state) returns valid SignalDecision in <1ms

subtasks.title: Apply signal decision to MetaDrive
subtasks.description: Create agent/signal_controller.py. Function apply_decision(env, decision: SignalDecision, step: int). (1) Inspect env.engine.traffic_manager.traffic_lights to map direction strings to MetaDrive traffic light IDs. (2) Set green for decision.phase direction lights. (3) Set red for all other direction lights. (4) Schedule yellow after duration_s steps using asyncio.sleep or step counter. (5) Log to SQLite via data/logger.log_decision(). (6) Emit decision + frame to dashboard via broadcaster. NOTE: This module is architecturally equivalent to SUMO traci.trafficlight.setPhase() — same concept, different env API. In Phase 2, swap MetaDrive calls for TraCI calls.
subtasks.test: apply_decision changes traffic light color visible in top-down frame

tasks.title: Emergency green corridor pipeline
tasks.description: Centrepiece demo feature. Two trigger paths: (A) YOLOv8 detects ambulance for 3 consecutive frames (debounce). (B) Dashboard dispatch button POST /api/emergency. Both paths fire identical pipeline: osmnx Delhi graph → Dijkstra route → LLM emergency context → Gemini reasons corridor → MetaDrive signals cleared → ambulance spawned and traverses.

subtasks.title: Random routing environment generator and cache
subtasks.description: Create routing/delhi_graph.py to generate a weighted random graph for routing tests. Function get_graph(): load cache from data/random_test_graph.gpickle if present, else generate and save. Include sample_route_test() to validate shortest-path flow without external Delhi/OSM connectivity.
subtasks.test: python routing/delhi_graph.py prints graph stats and a sample route. Cached graph reloads on second call.

subtasks.title: Dijkstra ambulance routing and demo routes
subtasks.description: Create routing/router.py. Function compute_route(G, origin_node, dest_node) -> list[int]: nx.shortest_path(G, origin_node, dest_node, weight='length'). Function get_demo_route(destination: str) -> list[str]: returns hardcoded junction label sequence for 3 demo routes: DEMO_ROUTES = {'AIIMS': ['J3','J2','J1','J0'], 'GTB_HOSPITAL': ['J3','J2','J1'], 'SAFDARJUNG': ['J2','J1','J0']}. These junction labels map to MetaDrive sim intersections. Function route_to_prompt_text(route) -> str: 'J3 → J2 → J1 → J0 (AIIMS, 2.3 km)'.
subtasks.test: get_demo_route('AIIMS') returns ['J3','J2','J1','J0']. route_to_prompt_text returns readable string.

subtasks.title: Ambulance event trigger and debounce
subtasks.description: Create emergency/event_handler.py. Class AmbulanceEventHandler with asyncio.Queue. Method on_cv_frame(ambulance_detected, ambulance_direction): if detected, increment detection_streak; if streak >= 3 and not corridor_active: fire event, reset streak. Method trigger_manual(ambulance_id, destination): directly fire event (called by POST /api/emergency). Event payload dataclass: AmbulanceEvent(ambulance_id, origin_direction, destination, route: list[str], nonce: str, timestamp: float). Place event on queue for corridor coordinator.
subtasks.test: 3 consecutive True detections fires exactly one event. Manual trigger fires event. Both have same AmbulanceEvent schema.

subtasks.title: Green corridor coordinator
subtasks.description: Create emergency/corridor.py. Async function activate_corridor(event: AmbulanceEvent, env, sio). Steps: (1) Call get_demo_route(event.destination). (2) spawn_ambulance(env, event.origin_direction). (3) For each junction on route: call apply_decision with emergency SignalDecision (phase=ambulance_direction, duration_s=30, emergency_detected=True). (4) Set corridor_active=True in global state. (5) Every second: sio.emit('emergency', {active:True, route:route, remaining_s:countdown}). (6) After 30s: resume normal LLM control, sio.emit('emergency', {active:False}). (7) Log corridor event to SQLite.

phase_2_components.description: Components deferred from MVP. Documented here so they are not forgotten. All are architecturally prepared for — MVP code is structured for minimal-change upgrades.

SUMO_TraCI.role: Production signal control API for connecting to real city intersection hardware via RS485/UDP
SUMO_TraCI.detail: traci.trafficlight.setPhase() is the production equivalent of MetaDrive engine.traffic_manager used in T03.7. When deploying to real intersections, agent/signal_controller.py MetaDrive calls are swapped for TraCI calls with minimal change. SUMO also provides Delhi .net.xml network for production-grade simulation.
SUMO_TraCI.why_deferred: Requires separate SUMO installation, Delhi .net.xml via netconvert, and TrafficDojo sync. Adds 2-3 days for no visible competition demo benefit — MetaDrive already handles simulation and signal control.
SUMO_TraCI.install: sudo apt install sumo && pip install traci sumo-rl
SUMO_TraCI.upgrade_path: After competition: install SUMO → generate delhi.net.xml from osmnx data → replace MetaDrive signal calls in signal_controller.py with traci.trafficlight.setPhase() → add TrafficDojo for dual-sim visual

TrafficDojo.role: SUMO↔MetaDrive synchronisation bridge — mirrors vehicle positions, speeds, and signal states between both simulators at each timestep
TrafficDojo.detail: Discovered March 2024. Bridges SUMO (signal control + simulation logic) and MetaDrive (3D visuals + RGB camera sensors). Provides intersection pole cameras at 10m height in MetaDrive. Only meaningful when BOTH SUMO and MetaDrive are running simultaneously.
TrafficDojo.why_deferred: Has zero role in MVP because MVP uses MetaDrive-only (no SUMO to sync). Becomes essential in Phase 2 when SUMO is added for production signal control.
TrafficDojo.upgrade_path: Phase 2: add SUMO → install TrafficDojo → SUMO runs signal logic, MetaDrive renders 3D visuals synced via TrafficDojo → RGB camera poles provide realistic CCTV input for YOLOv8

CoLLMLight.role: Cooperative multi-agent LLM coordination — each junction agent communicates with adjacent agents for city-wide green wave
CoLLMLight.detail: usail-hkust/CoLLMLight (2025). Extends LLMLight with inter-agent communication via GPT-4o. Agents share downstream PCE to pre-emptively extend/shorten green for green wave. MVP single-junction agent is the natural entry point — CoLLMLight adds inter-junction communication layer on top.
CoLLMLight.why_deferred: Multi-agent adds N API calls per decision step, increased latency, and coordination logic. Single-junction reasoning is sufficient for competition.
CoLLMLight.upgrade_path: Post-competition: replace single-agent call in llm_agent.py with CoLLMLight multi-agent loop

LightSim2.role: Ultra-fast headless benchmarking — 20,000 simulation steps/second for 30-seed statistical KPI validation
LightSim2.detail: pip install lightsim2. 16 real-world city scenarios. Gymnasium + PettingZoo API. Validate performance ranking of all 3 controllers with statistical significance (Mann-Whitney p<0.05). Use if single MetaDrive seed benchmark in T07.3 looks inconclusive.

wandb.role: Experiment tracking dashboard for KPI visualisation across all 3 controllers
wandb.detail: pip install wandb. Already in usail-hkust/LLMTSCS requirements.txt. Log step-by-step metrics per controller. Generates publication-quality comparison charts automatically. Optional if SQLite + matplotlib in T07.3 sufficient for competition pitch.
